title: Curvature at Infinity Governs the Topology of Complete Non-Compact Surfaces Admitting Schrödinger Operators of Finite Index
summary: In this article, we investigate the global topology of a complete non-compact Riemannian $2$-manifold $Σ$ admitting a Schrödinger operator with non-negative potential and finite Morse index.
